name: Takeshiba Asagi
source:
Weak spot: Being kissed or licked anywhere
Fetish: Be creampied in risky days.

[url=/c57067]Kou's[/url] classmate who barely has a presence and is timid, but also very kind. She voluntarily keeps doing stuff like watering the classroom's plants and keeping the blackboard clean. Asagi's current personality was formed because of her poisonous mother's behavior and ways of treating her. Because of this, she always looked up to the Harumi family members always "getting along" and wanting to be loved like that.
